title: Juce's Crafting Overhaul
description: A simple yet extensive datapack aimed to expand Minecraft recipes greatly
body:
An *extensive* crafting datapack made to ENHANCE recipes, not make new ones. The datapack, as of the v1.0.0 release contains over 450 recipes with the goal of expanding this over time, creating a truly reimagined crafting experience for the end-user.

As it's a datapack, it is compatible with all launchers, including servers running GeyserMC, meaning you can enjoy it with your Bedrock Edition friends!
